# 20 Minutes Remaining

- Finish off what you are working on.
- Do not start anything new that will be hard to stop safely.

# 15 Minutes Remaining

- Start cleaning.
- Put away tools and materials.
- Reset your workspace.

# 10 Minutes Remaining

- Finish any required submission.
- Complete your reflection / daily log.
- Return to your assigned desk or station.

# 5 Minutes Remaining

- Required work ends.
- Nothing else gets started.
- Be at your desk, quiet and ready to finish class.

# Quiet Reset

**3 minutes**

- No phones.
- No talking or making noise.
- Chill music plays.

# Final 2 Minutes

- Different music plays.
- You may talk, use your phone, or relax.
- Wait for the bell.

# Be Present
